findings.title: Next typing replaces the independent AI navigation policy with the hotstring lifetime
findings.reproduction: Actual public Keymap: type bonjour, navigate, type x. AIreset=false+wordreset=true retains context immediately then loses it to x; AIreset=true+wordreset=false clears immediately then resurrects bonjourx. Arrow and shortcut crossproducts plus click. Separate actual request serializer confirms omission/resurrection over fake HTTP.
findings.root_cause: Bridge.check_nav_reset applies independent retention correctly, but update_preview_body subsequently sets llm_buffer from ai_context_of(cursor-relative hotstring buffer), overriding the independent lifetime on the next edit.
findings.silent_failure: Typing and requests succeed without diagnostics; registered navigation regression checks immediate retention but not next ordinary-character continuity.
findings.regression_test: Actual public arrow/shortcut/click followed by ordinary typing and edits under both preference crossproducts; independently retain or clear AI text through actual request serialization while keeping private redaction and cursor-safe hotstring resets.

findings.title: Terminal empty-prompt receipt recognizes main Return but excludes keypad Enter
findings.reproduction: Condition: classified terminal accepts bare keypadEnter as submission and later Backspaces at empty prompt. Actual public Keymap/TOML fixture: a,submit,a,Backspacex2,r. MainReturn36 emits word-only r→R; keypad76 CR/ETX controls retain pre-submit word and emitno expansion. Native receiving is unexecuted.
findings.root_cause: Main Keymap terminal-empty-prompt and no-prediction reset branches check only Keycodes.RETURN36, although generated HID identity and Bridge explicitly support keypadEnter76 as equivalent Enter-family identity.
findings.silent_failure: No exception or diagnostic; mainReturn-only registered empty-prompt regressions pass, and keypad state is treated as ordinary retained typed text.
findings.regression_test: Actual public main/keypad Enter family, supported native payloads, conditional terminal-submit+empty-prompt deletion and subsequent word-only rules; preserve multiline/ShiftReturn, predictions, pause/focus refusal and terminals with different keypad bindings.
